senses.gloss: नह (-औ) औनह r. 4th cl. (नह्यति-ते) To bind: see णह ।

नाह m. (-हः)
 1. Binding, confinement.
 2. A trap, a snare for catching
deer, &c.
 3. Obstruction in any organ or secretion of the body,
as costiveness, &c.
 E. णह् to bind, affix भावे घञ् ।

नहि ind. No, not.
 E. णह् to bind or tie, affix इन् ।

नहुष m. (-षः)
 1. The name of a Nāga or serpent.
 2. The name of a
king, one of the lunar race, son of AYUS and grandson of PURŪ-
RAVAS.
 E. णह् to bind, Unādi affix उषन्.

नहुषात्मज m. (-जः) A king, also YAYĀTI.
 E. नहुष as above, आत्मज son.
नाहल m. (-लः) A man of a barbarous or outcast tribe.

नाहुषि m. (-षिः) The name of a king; also YAYĀTI.
 E. नहुष, and इञ्
affix of descent. Also नाहुष ।
